PERFORMANCE WORK STATEMENT
1.0 BACKGROUND
The Cincinnati VA Medical Center (VAMC) will be activating a new air handler unit for pharmacy with the potential move date being late-2026/early-2027, November-May. Due to personnel constraints, we are requesting the use of specialized movers to relocate medical equipment and testing  needed to keep up with current inpatient care medication. The current pharmaceutical iv hoods, 3200 Vine St., Cincinnati, OH 45220 fifth floor will be required to move to second floor  (back up eighth floor depending on room availability). This will allow room certification testing so the Cincinnati pharmacy department can continue to create medications for patients within the hospital and CLC.  

SCOPE OF WORK
The purpose of this contract is to provide relocation and moving services for the VA Medical Center at 3200 Vine St., Cincinnati, OH 45220. Moving and relocation services could include disassembly and assembly of iv hoods, disconnecting and reconnecting of medical equipment, disconnecting and reconnecting electricity from the equipment. The Contractor shall provide non-personal services, laborers, contractor operated vehicles, equipment, supplies, transportation, tools, materials, supervision, to perform relocation and moving services for Cincinnati VAMC as defined in the PWS. The contractor shall not connect to or have access to the VA Network at any time.
This work should also include room recertification of the medical equipment for non-hazardous pharmacy iv hoods. Testing will allow for pharmacy to continue medication for use of patients and minimize down time of the current iv space.
The contractor will then return all equipment to its original location after communicating with COR, process will take 2-4 weeks after original relocation date has been chosen.
3.0 CONTRACT TYPE
Firm-Fixed Price.
4.0 PERIOD OF PERFORMANCE
Due to the fluid nature of construction, there is not a set date established for the move of the facility, the current period of performance would be November 2026- May 2027. The total number of days required for the work can be established by the contractor and COR during the kick-off meeting, floor plans with the square footage will be provided by the government in the PWS to assist with planning. The government will keep the contractor informed on potential move dates weekly to ensure that proper planning can be completed.
Weekend and after-hour work may be required.
5.0 PLACE OF PERFORMANCE
From: The Cincinnati VAMC located at  3200 Vine St., Cincinnati, Ohio 45220 fifth floor pharmacy.
To: The Cincinnati VAMC located at  3200 Vine St., Cincinnati, Ohio 45220 second floor (or eighth floor depending on room availability) .
Back: To original location The Cincinnati VAMC located at  3200 Vine St., Cincinnati, Ohio 45220 fifth floor pharmacy.
6.0 TRAVEL
The Government does not anticipate(s) travel under this effort. All work will be within the main Cincinnati VAMC building.

7.0 TASK STATEMENT
The Contractor shall provide the following services to support the Cincinnati VAMC clinic office move operations. In addition, the Contractor shall provide all the necessary supplies, materials, equipment, and personnel to fulfil the Government s requirement. At no time during the performance of the contract shall the contractor personnel manage or oversee any federal government personnel.
a. Loading and unloading equipment to move items to and from Cincinnati VAMC floors as needed.
b. Delivering/hauling  medical equipment, and supplies.
c. Disconnection and reconnection of medical equipment, if needed, in alignment with manufacturer recommendations.
d. Disconnecting and reconnecting electrical power from the workstations, if needed, in alignment with manufacturer recommendations.
f. Setting up and reassembling workstations, or medical equipment, as directed by the COR in alignment with manufacturer recommendations.
g. Moving and arranging medical equipment or workstations in alignment with manufacturer recommendations.
h. Disassembly of medical equipment or workstations to facilitate move, if needed, in alignment with manufacturer recommendations.
i. Submit Certificate of Public Convenience and Necessity (CPCN) from the Ohio PUCO 48 hours in advance of any scheduled move or relocation, which shall be inclusive of driver proofs of identification, commercial licensure, certifications, and any VA security documentation (Privacy training certificate) if needed for access to Government facilities. Liability insurance as part of this certification shall eclipse the anticipated value of equipment being relocated and should cover damages to the facilities.
j. Shall provide ALL packing materials (i.e. moving boxes, cartons, packing material etc.) and equipment to move requested medical equipment, workstations and supplies.
k. Shall pack the equipment, furniture, and supplies into appropriate containers (e.g., boxes, bubble wrap, protective materials) to ensure safe transport and prevent damage.
